title: Axiom-Fi
tagline: The first agentic trading terminal with on-chain verifiable reputation and performance.
description:
Axiom-Fi is the first autonomous agentic trading terminal where agents build a verifiable on-chain reputation and charge fees based on proven performance. While traditional DeFi bots are "black boxes," Axiom-Fi orchestrates a transparent pipeline of specialized AI agents—Research, Risk Guard, and Executor—that collaborate to execute complex strategies.

Every decision made by the agents is cryptographically signed and anchored to 0G Storage, creating an immutable audit trail. By leveraging 0G KV as a decentralized reputation registry, the system tracks each agent's accuracy and risk-management history. This allows the Orchestrator to select the most reliable sub-agents for any given task. Users can trigger strategies via a premium web terminal or a Telegram bot, with the entire economic loop powered by x402 micropayments, ensuring that for the first time in DeFi, the tools themselves have something to lose.
how_its_made:
Axiom-Fi is built as a modular agentic system deep-rooted in the 0G Network ecosystem, utilizing 0G Storage to maintain an immutable audit trail of agent logs and decision proofs to ensure 100% auditability. We leveraged 0G KV as our high-speed decentralized state layer to manage user preferences and the real-time "Agent Reputation Scoreboard," while integrating 0G Compute to run high-performance market analysis models for the intelligence layer. The technical stack features a Next.js 15+ frontend styled with Tailwind CSS 4.0 and Framer Motion to achieve a premium "Glassmorphism" terminal aesthetic, paired with custom TypeScript agents that utilize the 0G SDK and the GrammY framework for a seamless Telegram interface.

On-chain execution is handled through an integration with KeeperHub on Base Sepolia to settle trades via Uniswap V3, with the x402 protocol facilitating reputation-indexed agent-to-agent micropayments. A particularly notable technical achievement was our deterministic agent identity system, which derives unique agent wallets from a master seed to allow for fully auditable transactions without centralized management. Throughout the development process, we enforced a strict "No-Mock" policy, ensuring that every interaction—from storage uploads to KV lookups—hits live 0G nodes to maintain the highest standard of decentralization and reliability.
